about: Server-side DataTables requests captured verbatim from the NYPL Prints & Photographs Discovery tool (ppd: Next.js, datatables.net 2.3.8 with SearchBuilder, FixedColumns, Buttons, Select) while its real UI was driven in headless Chrome. Each `request` is the JSON body the browser POSTed, minus the `columns` array, which is identical for every request on a table and stored once under `tables`. `live` is what the server (running dtajax2sql 0.3.10) answered at capture time; `expect` is what the current library must do with the request against the schema in schema.sql.
